source.title: Formula DRIFT Long Beach Top 16 ALL ACTION
source.reuse_status: Not verified; local file supplied by user; keep raw footage private

title: Complete green pink and orange blue tandem run
label: Green pink lead and orange blue chase complete tandem run
purpose: Full run demonstration and review; includes material already used in the sparse test clips and is not an additional independent test
interval_convention: Half open source frame intervals; each shot includes its start frame and excludes its end frame
completeness_basis: AI assistant visually inspected the continuous source interval. Launch, initiation, bridge transition, outer zone, final hairpin, and both cars straightening into the visible exit are shown before the first pit shot at frame 57936. The catalog covers all 801 source frames without omitted interior intervals; no replay or talking segment is selected.
limitations: Complete coverage refers to the run as presented in the local broadcast, not continuous observation of every car pixel or verification of official course timing. Smoke, overlap, motion blur, trees, and camera cuts interrupt visibility. Car descriptions and approximate reference boxes were drafted by AI assistant independently of detector predictions, with no human expert review. Reference boxes and travel order are not tracking IDs. Physical distance, drift angle, speed, and official judging are unavailable from these images.
